formula_verified: ESOP Tax: At exercise: Perquisite = FMV at exercise − Exercise Price. Taxed as salary at applicable slab. At sale: Capital gains = Sale Price − FMV at exercise. LTCG @10% (equity, listed, >1yr holding, above ₹1L) or STCG @20%. Unlisted shares: different rates.
